queries.query: SELECT id as Id, titulo as Titulo, descricao as Descricao, data as Data, tipo_evento as TipoEvento, autor_id as AutorId, texto_acao as TextoAcao, link_acao as LinkAcao FROM evento
INSERT INTO evento (titulo, descricao, data, tipo_evento, autor_id, texto_acao, link_acao ) VALUES (@Titulo, @Descricao,@Data,@TipoEvento,@AutorId, @TextoAcao, @LinkAcao) RETURNING id;
SELECT id as Id, titulo as Titulo, descricao as Descricao, data as Data, tipo_evento as TipoEvento, autor_id as AutorId, texto_acao as TextoAcao, link_acao as LinkAcao FROM evento WHERE id=@id
UPDATE evento SET titulo = @Titulo, descricao = @Descricao, data = @Data, tipo_evento = @TipoEvento, texto_acao = @TextoAcao, link_acao = @LinkAcao WHERE id=@id

SELECT id as Id, titulo as Titulo, descricao as Descricao, data as Data, tipo_evento as TipoEvento, autor_id as AutorId, texto_acao as TextoAcao, link_acao as LinkAcao, COUNT(*) OVER() as TotalCount FROM evento WHERE 1=1 AND (@SearchPattern IS NULL OR titulo ILIKE @SearchPattern OR descricao ILIKE @SearchPattern) AND (@Type IS NULL OR tipo_evento = @Type) AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR data >= @DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR data <= @DateTo) ORDER BY data DESC OFFSET (@Page - 1) * @Limit LIMIT @Limit
